text:
Product Overview
PM3008GSN-PD is 8-port 10/100/1000Mbps Switch with 7 port PoE(Port1~7). Port8 is PD port, Support 95W input. Power supply support external power supply and PoE.
The electrical power and data transmission on the same cable can expand your network to the places where no power lines or outlets, where you can install devices such as APs, IP cameras, or IP phones etc.
Features
Complies with IEEE802.3af/at Standard;
Supports PoE Power up to 30W for each PoE port；
1*95W PD Port（Port8）；
Auto detect power device; will not burned non-standard PoE device or normal PoE switch;
Supports port power supply prioritization, guarantee the continuous power supply of key nodes；
Supports IEEE802.3 x full duplex flow control and Backpressure half duplex flow control;
Line-speed forwarding, intelligent identification;
Supports storage -and - forward for Data exchange;
Iron case, no fan;
